questions.query: I consent to participate in this parent survey
questions.text:
Research Study Consent - Parent Survey (Control Group)

Study Title: Resource Allocation and Child Development Study - Control Group

Purpose: You have been randomly assigned to the control group. This survey examines your attitudes and beliefs about educational investment decisions for your children.

What you will do: Answer questions about your parenting approach and investment philosophy. This should take approximately 10-15 minutes.

Confidentiality: Your responses will be kept strictly confidential and used only for research purposes.

Voluntary Participation: Participation is voluntary. You may withdraw at any time.
Thank you for participating in this study. This survey asks about your approach to investing in {child1name} and {child2name}'s education and development.

questions.query: What is your highest level of education?
Please provide the ages of your children (in years):
How satisfied are you with each child's current educational progress? (1 = Very dissatisfied, 5 = Very satisfied):
Rate each child's motivation to learn (1 = Very low, 5 = Very high):
Rate each child's effort level in school (1 = Very low, 5 = Very high):
Approximately how many hours per week do you spend on the following activities?
Which factors are most important to you when deciding how to invest in your children's education? (Select all that apply)
Do you believe parents should invest equally in all children regardless of their abilities?
values: Somewhat disagree - Investment should vary based on needs
Strongly disagree - Investment should be based on potential

questions.query: In your own words, describe your philosophy about how to allocate educational resources (like tutoring, extra lessons, or learning materials) between {child1name} and {child2name}.
For each hypothetical scenario, which child would you prioritize?
prefixes: One child can attend a special summer program
Budget for music lessons for one child

questions.query: How difficult do you find it to make decisions about allocating educational resources between {child1name} and {child2name}?
questions.prefix: Rate the difficulty level (1 = Very easy, 5 = Very difficult)

questions.query: What factors make it difficult (or easy) for you to decide how to allocate resources between {child1name} and {child2name}?

questions.text: Thank you for completing this survey. Your responses will help us better understand how parents make educational investment decisions for their children.
